items.a: Two things. A course of 26 short videos that teaches you how to take on a commercial client properly, and 14 ready made packs, one for each kind of commercial space, that do the asking for you. A pack is a set of 14 files, everything from the questions you ask in the first meeting right up to the page the client signs before you start designing.

items.q: I have never done a commercial project. Will I understand it?
items.a: Yes. It starts from the very beginning and assumes zero experience with commercial work or with systems. You watch a real store and a real restaurant get onboarded end to end, and then you can run any of the other 12.

items.q: Only two spaces are taught in full. What about my clinic, or my office, or my hotel?
items.a: You get all 14 packs whatever your project is. The course teaches a store and a restaurant end to end because they are the two far ends of the range, and every other space sits between them. Module 7 walks you through the other 12 in Brief, and each pack comes with its own guide that runs it start to finish.

items.q: My client will never sit through this many questions.
items.a:
They never do it all at once, and that is the whole design of the system. A light set of questions before the yes, and the deeper details get asked after either on WhatsApp or on a meeting.

Also, Module 6 gives you the exact methods for the client who pushes back or goes silent.

items.q: Do I need to buy any software?
items.a: No. The packs sit in Notion, and Notion's free plan covers everything here. Everything that goes to your client goes on WhatsApp or your choice of medium. There is nothing to buy on top of this.

items.q: Will it work for a small project, like a 400 square foot cafe?
items.a:
Yes. You only run the zones your project actually has.

Like a small cafe has fewer zones than a hotel, so it uses fewer modules (Questionnaires). The system runs the same whether it is a Small independent place or a chain outlet in a metro or small town, the process is identical.

Straight after payment. You are taken to your dashboard with everything inside it, and you also get an order confirmation email with your access within 5 to 10 minutes. Check spam if you do not see it. Log in with the email/phone number you paid with and start.

items.q: What is the difference between the three plans?
items.a:
All 3 Plans give you the Full 26-video course, all 3 bonuses, and free updates forever. The only thing that changes is which space packs you get. Retail and Restaurant/Cafe come with every plan, because they are the two the course teaches in full.

1. "Everyday & Common Spaces" gives you the 8 spaces designers get asked for most often: Office, Co-working, Showroom, Salon & Spa, Gym & Fitness and Event & Banquet + Retail & Restaurant / Cafe
2. "Large & Specialised Spaces" gives you the 8 bigger, more regulated ones: Hotel, Healthcare, Educational, Theatre & Cinema, Museum & Gallery and Factory & Warehouse + Retail & Restaurant / Cafe
3. "All Spaces" gives you all 14, so whatever enquiry lands next, you already have the system for it.

So pick by the work you actually get. Mostly offices, salons and showrooms, take "1. Everyday & Common". Mostly hotels, hospitals and institutions, take "2. Large & Specialised". A bit of everything, take All Spaces, which is what most designers do.

Yes. 100% money back. Use it on your next project, and if it's not for you, write to support@eazydezyn.com and we will refund you.

Yes. The price goes up every time new lessons and updates are added. Everyone who buys now gets every future update free, forever. So the earlier you buy, the less you pay and the more you end up with.

items.q: Why not just use a free commercial questionnaire from the internet?
items.a: Because a free questionnaire is a list somebody generated from AI, which doesn't know shit about running an Interior design or Architecture business. You do not know who wrote it, whether they have ever run a project in India, or why any question is on the list. So you send it, clients don't even fill it, and you still do not have what your design needs, because the questions that matter are not the obvious ones. What I'm giving you is not a list of questions, it is the whole process, built and run on 50+ real projects, with the course that makes it work and a signed brief at the end that protects you. I know exactly what I have made and I am very confident about what it does for you. If it does not do it, you get your money back. As simple as that.

items.a: Well then you might want to check your emails, your spam folders, and promotion folders once, so that you can find our updated access link which includes everything that's mentioned here. If for any reason it didn't reach you, email support@eazydezyn.com and we will sort you out.
